title: Budget alerts wired to an action rather than an email

videos.script: The usual budget alert is an e-mail to whoever administers billing. It arrives, and nothing happens. {{email}} A Cloud Billing budget is an amount, a period, and rules about when to say something. It stops nothing. {{budget}} The rule that matters most is the forecast. It warns on the ninth, not the thirtieth. {{forecast}} Instead of an inbox, the budget can publish to a Pub/Sub topic. You will wire that topic to a function on your own computer. It opens a ticket at eighty percent, pages at a hundred, and stops the machines in a sandbox. {{wire}} And it acts once. The topic repeats the same state many times a day, so a function that acted on every message would page all month. {{once}} Then the harder question. Which action is safe to run while nobody is looking? {{safe}}
